turns.user_utterance: This is URGENT, I typed the wrong payment information for a payment I needed to make and have clicked send, I need to reverse the transaction immediately.
turns.assistant_response: I’m sorry this is urgent—can you confirm what type of payment you sent (bank transfer or card payment)? If it’s a transfer, tell me whether the recipient has already received it (or if it’s still pending), and the approximate time you sent it. I’ll guide you on the fastest way to try to reverse/cancel it.

turns.user_utterance: It was a bank transfer, still pending – I sent it about 12 minutes ago.
turns.assistant_response: Got it—since it’s a bank transfer and still pending (about 12 minutes ago), you may be able to cancel it. Please open the app and go to Transfers/Payments → find that transfer → select Cancel. If you can’t see the Cancel option, tell me what screen you’re on (or the transfer status shown), and I’ll advise the next best step.
